post.summary: Convert a lead into a generated order
post.description:
Converts a lead to an order: resolves and encrypts the customer payment method, stamps price/pickup/address onto the master lead, generates a pickup OTP, then either auto-assigns the order to a vendor the customer already works with, reserves it for that vendor, or broadcasts it to all eligible vendors.

**Notes:** Note the payload is WRAPPED: the validated object sits under a top-level `request` key. Heavy side effects - mutates money and vendor credits: may auto-assign the order and DEBIT the vendor's credit balance (writes a vendor creditLog), or create a 48-hour ReservedLeads hold and set the lead to Reserved. Generates a 4-digit pickup OTP (leadOtp). Sends Firebase push to eligible vendors and to the customer app, plus an order-generated email to the customer; WhatsApp is sent separately by CashkrBackend via Pabbly Chatflow. UPI/bank PII is encrypted with the shared field-level scheme. Writes leadLogs and AdminActivityLog. Auth is weak: any non-empty Authorization header satisfies the check. Audited via withAuditLog as LEAD/UPDATE.

_Source: `app/api/completeMyLead/route.ts`_

_Auth: `other: bearer accessToken cookie or Authorization header (any non-empty value passes); NextAuth session is read only for the sales-rep name`_

401.description: No accessToken cookie and no Authorization header

post.summary: Proxy a tech support issue to the backend
post.description:
Server-side proxy that forwards a multipart form (including any attachments) to https://api.cashkr.com/createTechSupport with the backend admin token attached, so the token is never exposed to the browser. The upstream status and JSON body are passed straight back.

**Notes:** UPSTREAM PROXY: calls https://api.cashkr.com/createTechSupport with Authorization: Bearer $BACKEND_ADMIN_TOKEN added server-side. Admin session required (requireAdminSession). Content type is multipart/form-data - do not set Content-Type manually. The response status mirrors the upstream status; a thrown error is returned with a 200 and success:false. Exported as `const POST = ...; export { POST }`.

_Source: `app/api/createTechSupport/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

post.summary: Mark a lead as failed and reverse credits
post.description:
Marks a MasterLead as Failed inside a transaction: creates or updates the FailedLead record with a reason, reverses the vendor's credit points, cancels any reservations, writes lead logs, invalidates the orders cache and pushes a notification to the vendor.

**Notes:** SIDE EFFECTS: mutates vendor credit balance (credits are returned to the vendor), cancels reservations, and sends a Firebase push notification VENDOR_LEAD_FAILED. Errors such as 'No lead found' surface as 500, not 404. No handler-level auth check — the session is only read to attribute the AdminActivityLog entry.

_Source: `app/api/failedLead/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

example.message: Lead ID is a required field

500.description: Lead not found or already failed

example.message: Lead has already been marked as failed

post.summary: List failed leads with fuzzy search
post.description:
Returns a page of MasterLeads that have a failedLead record with primaryStatus in FailedByVendor/FailedByCashkr/FailedByCustomer/FailedByCashboy, filtered by device type, city, secondary status and pickup-date range. When 'search' is supplied the filtered set is re-ranked in memory with Fuse.js over token, email, phone, device model and customer name.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. Page size is hard-coded to 10 and the filtered set is loaded fully into memory before pagination, so wide filters are expensive.

_Source: `app/api/getAllFailedLeads/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

**Notes:** Upstream: process.env.BACKEND_API + /getmessages, authenticated with BACKEND_ADMIN_TOKEN. No caller auth; errors are swallowed and returned as HTTP 200 with success:false.

_Source: `app/api/getMessage/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

post.description:
Main telecaller queue. Returns paginated MasterLeads with primaryStatus New / secondaryStatus Initiated / isCompleted 0, filtered by device type, city, date range, tier, disposition, connection status and assigned admin. Multi-term searches are additionally filtered and relevance-ranked in memory.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. Customer phones prefixed DELETED_ are unmasked into a clean number with isDeleted:true. When searching, up to min(1000, limit*10) rows are pulled and paginated in memory.

_Source: `app/api/getallleads/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

example.message: An error occurred while processing your request

post.summary: List booked orders with Redis caching
post.description:
Primary orders queue: paginated MasterLeads with isCompleted = 1, filtered by status (Completed / Reserved / PickupDelayed / any secondaryStatus), device type, city, cancellation source, schedule window and date range. Results are cached in Redis for 10-20 seconds keyed on the full filter set.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. Backed by Redis with short TTLs (search 10s, others 20s) because CashkrBackend writes the same MasterLeads rows and cannot invalidate this cache. Sets an HTTP Cache-Control header on the response.

_Source: `app/api/getallorders/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

get.description:
Paginated MasterLeads that carry hotLeadAt, filtered by hot-lead type and status, hydrated with the same relations as /api/getallleads so rows feed the shared detail sheet. Each row adds minutesSinceHot and, when a HOT_LEAD RedirectLink exists, a short checkoutUrl.

**Notes:** The handler does not check the session itself; since 2026-09-05 the deny-by-default middleware enforces an admin session for this route. Reads hotLead* columns written by CashkrBackend's Pabbly intent webhook and hotLeadSweep cron. checkoutUrl is omitted unless SHORT_LINK_BASE is set and a HOT_LEAD RedirectLink exists.

_Source: `app/api/hot-leads/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check in the handler; middleware.ts skips /api/*.

Moves a hot lead through the telecaller lifecycle by writing hotLeadStatus plus hotLeadStatusUpdatedAt/By on MasterLeads. Attribution uses the session email, falling back to the numeric admin id.

**Notes:** getServerSession(authOptions) is enforced in the handler. CashkrBackend's hotLeadSweep cron writes the same columns with updatedBy 'system'.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Plain error envelope `{ error }` used by most routes. `error` is a human-readable message.

status.description: One of: new, contacted, converted, dead

UnspecifiedObject.description: Response body shape not captured by the source re-audit (only the status code was detected). Any JSON object.

AnyObject.description: Arbitrary JSON object; the route forwards or stores it without declaring a shape.

CodedErrorEnvelope.description: Structured error envelope `{ success: false, error: { code, message } }`.

city.description: Case-insensitive contains match on the lead address city

page.description: 1-based page; page size is fixed at 10

(passthrough).description: Every form field is forwarded verbatim to the upstream backend; this route does not inspect or validate any of them. Send whatever https://api.cashkr.com/createTechSupport expects (typically issue subject, description, lead/order reference and file attachments).

search.description: Free text; matched on token, leadId, customer name/email/phone, device model, city, pincode

city.description: Customer address city; 'all' disables the filter

statusFilter.description: All | Not Called | Callbacks | High Ends (default 'All')

status.description: Same vocabulary as statusFilter; drives the extra AND conditions

assignedAdminId.description: Admin id, array of ids, 'unassigned' or 'all' — drives the My Leads / All Leads toggle

request.paymentMode.description: Prisma paymentType enum: UPI | Bank | Cash | Wallet

request.addressId.description: Existing address id; 400s if it does not exist

request.deviceType.description: Device type, e.g. Mobile or Laptop

request.paymentId.description: UUID of an already-saved Payments record to link instead of creating one

request.upiId.description: UPI id, used when paymentMode is UPI. Stored encrypted.

request.accountNumber.description: Bank account number, used when paymentMode is Bank. Stored encrypted.

request.bankName.description: Bank name. NOT encrypted (matches the backend).

search.description: Free text on token / leadId / device model

leadid.description: MasterLeads.leadId to fail (note the all-lowercase key)

reason.description: Free-text failure reason stored on FailedReason

MessageEnvelope.description: Message-only envelope `{ message }`; used for both success and failure responses.

search.description: Free text on token / customer / device

cancellationSource.description: Filter by who cancelled (customer chat attribution)

fromDate.description: Range start; for status Completed the window is resolved against real completion events in LeadLogs

CodedErrorDetailsEnvelope.description: Structured error envelope `{ success: false, error: { code, message, details } }`.

OkErrorEnvelope.description: Error envelope `{ ok: false, error }` used by cron / sync style routes.

SuccessMessageEnvelope.description: Envelope `{ success, message }`; `success` is `true` on 2xx and `false` on error responses.

deviceType.description: DeviceType enum value, e.g. Mobile, Laptop, Camera

Unauthorized.description: Unauthenticated - no valid admin session (NextAuth cookie), or the expected token/secret is missing or wrong. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

InternalServerError.description: Internal server error - unhandled failure inside the route handler. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

BadRequest.description: Bad request / validation error - a required field is missing or invalid. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

UnauthorizedOkFlag.description: Unauthenticated - no valid admin session. Variant for routes that use the `{ ok, error }` envelope.

NotFound.description: Not found - the referenced record does not exist. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

UntypedJsonBody.description: JSON body accepted as-is; the route does not declare a shape (forwarded upstream or validated inside the handler).

cookieAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth JWT session cookie from logging in to the admin panel. On HTTPS the cookie name is `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`.

cronBearer.description: `LINODE_CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token — every cron job goes through `assertCronAuth` in `lib/linode/cron-auth.ts`, which reads only this variable (despite some jobs being non-Linode).

unverifiedAccessToken.name: Authorization
unverifiedAccessToken.description: Legacy customer routes: an `accessToken` cookie or an `Authorization` header must be PRESENT, but the value is never verified. Not real authentication.

adsWebhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
adsWebhookSecret.description: `ADS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, sent either as the `x-webhook-secret` header or as a `secret` field in the JSON body. If the env var is unset the route rejects every call with 401 (it does not fall through to unauthenticated access).

webhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
webhookSecret.description: Generic `x-webhook-secret` header check for an inbound webhook.

cronSecretBearer.description: `CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token, compared with `bearerMatches` in `lib/auth/secret-compare.ts`. Distinct from `cronBearer`, which uses `LINODE_CRON_SECRET`.
